entities.name: Accounting of Hours
entities.description: The primary religious text of the Amonkheti during Nicol Bolas's reign, made up of prophecies.

entities.name: Amonkheti
entities.description: The people of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon who reigned as God-Pharaoh of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where the Accounting of Hours was the religious text.

entities.name: Hour of Revelation
entities.description: The Hour in which the Gate to the Afterlife opens, revealing Razaketh.

entities.name: Hour of Glory
entities.description: The Hour in which the Scorpion God kills Rhonas and locusts descend on Naktamun.

entities.name: Hour of Promise
entities.description: The Hour in which the Locust God destroys the Hekma and the Scorpion God kills Oketra and Kefnet.

entities.name: Hour of Eternity
entities.description: The Hour in which Bolas' army of Eternals is unleashed.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: The Hour in which Naktamun is destroyed and the Gatewatch is defeated.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon revealed beyond the Gate to the Afterlife who turns the Luxa River to blood.

entities.name: Luxa River
entities.description: River on Amonkhet turned to blood by Razaketh.

entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: A god who kills Rhonas, Oketra and Kefnet.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: The strongest of the gods of Amonkhet, killed by the Scorpion God.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City on Amonkhet descended upon by locusts and destroyed.

entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: A god whose swarm destroys the Hekma.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: A protective structure destroyed by the Locust God's swarm.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet killed by the Scorpion God.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet killed by the Scorpion God.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Bolas' army of living weapons.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers defeated in the Hour of Devastation.

entities.name: Record of Days
entities.description: A new text begun by survivors on Amonkhet after the Hour of Devastation and the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Amonkhet survivors began a new text.
